title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.

The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.

Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.

You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.

To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.

Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.

We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.

What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.

Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.

Media pitching and spokesperson training

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.

Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.

About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done.
  • You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.
  • You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.
  • You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes.
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.

Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.

What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

  • Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Ai Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Creative Producer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows.
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations? In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration:1 year Employment type:Independent contractor agreement Location:Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to:Senior Director Salary:Approx. USD$50,000 depending on location Application closing date:June 1st 9am BSTHow to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.Who we're looking for We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD$50,000 depending on location and experience.How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.
  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
    ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veeva Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Required Skills & Experience

- Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.

- Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.

- Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.

- Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.

Job Description

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.

Compensation:

$20/hr to $25/hr.

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.

The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.

Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.

You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.

To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.

Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.

We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.

What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.

Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.

Media pitching and spokesperson training

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.

Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31.
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.

About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it.
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side.
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done.
  • You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too.
  • You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on.
  • You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails.
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes.
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.

Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively.
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.

What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.

How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

  • Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Sdr & Client Acquisition Specialist (Brasil)
description:

SDR & Client Acquisition Specialist, Remote | Part-Time R$1,500 – R$2,000/month + performance bonuses (potential to grow to full-time)

We're a UK-based performance marketing agency working with aesthetics and beauty clinics. We're looking for a confident, organised SDR to both work inbound leads for our clients AND help us grow the agency through outbound prospecting.

What You'll Do:

  • Call inbound leads quickly after submission and book them into consultations
  • Follow up with warm and cold leads consistently
  • Qualify prospects and handle objections professionally
  • Reach out to potential new clients for the agency via cold calls, DMs and email
  • Log all activity in the CRM and keep pipelines clean and accurate
  • Work closely with the marketing team and report daily on results

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong spoken English is ESSENTIAL —>
    you must be able to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently at a near-native or fully fluent level, with excellent pronunciation and strong conversational ability
  • Comfortable making high volumes of calls
  • Experience with cold calling and CRM systems (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Organised, reliable, and hungry to grow
  • Proactive by nature — you don't wait to be told what to do
  • Someone who takes full ownership of their results — no excuses
  • Willing to learn, improve, and take feedback seriously

This is NOT for you if:

  • You need constant hand-holding
  • You make excuses instead of making calls
  • You're looking for something easy and low-effort
  • You avoid accountability when things don't go your way

This IS for you if:

  • You're self-driven and take initiative
  • You own your results — good and bad
  • You're hungry to learn and grow with a team
  • You want a role where performance is actually rewarded

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with UK or US clients
  • Background in high-ticket services or consultation booking
  • Familiarity with marketing funnels and CRM automations

Compensation & Growth:

  • Base: R$1,500 – R$2,000/month (part-time)
  • Performance bonuses for strong results
  • Real opportunity to grow into a full-time role for the right person

Hard workers who take ownership get rewarded here. If that's you — apply below.

To apply: send a 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself and why you're the right person for this role.

LER COM EXTREMA ATENÇÃO

Estamos em busca de um(a) Closer Jurídico com perfil analítico, excelente comunicação e foco estratégico em conversão de clientes. Somos um escritório de advocacia boutique em fase de expansão de nossa estrutura comercial e buscamos um profissional para liderar o fechamento de novos negócios.

Se você possui sólida experiência em fechamento de contratos de serviços jurídicos, agilidade no atendimento de demandas e busca uma oportunidade com perspectiva real de crescimento para cargos de liderança, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe.

  • Foco em Resultados: Conversão efetiva de leads em contratos assinados, visando o atingimento das metas de faturamento do escritório.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Experiência prévia e comprovada como Closer Jurídico (fechamento de contratos de prestação de serviços advocatícios).

  • Organização e disciplina para o cumprimento de metas de desempenho.
Condições e Benefícios
  • Regime de Contratação: Prestador de Serviços (PJ).
  • Jornada de Trabalho: Período integral.
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido (mínimo de 2 dias por semana presenciais na sede do escritório para alinhamento estratégico, e os demais dias em regime de home office).
  • Remuneração: Honorário fixo compatível com o mercado + Comissão atrativa por contrato fechado (remuneração variável com base em desempenho).
  • Perspectiva de Carreira: O profissional que se destacar no atingimento de metas estruturará a área comercial, com plano de transição futura para a posição de Gerente ou Diretor Comercial.

title: Técnico De Telecomunicações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico De Telecomunicações em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções para infraestrutura, indústria, TI, IoT, redes de comunicação, energia, utilities e projetos de engenharia.

Diferente de plataformas tradicionais de listagem de produtos, a SolutionMall oferece suporte estruturado aos clientes, incluindo esclarecimento de requisitos, seleção técnica, correspondência de produtos, coordenação com fornecedores, suporte a RFQ, cotações, entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Em sistemas de comunicação, a SolutionMall apoia produtos e soluções relacionados a:

  • Sistemas de comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF e radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Comunicação por fibra óptica
  • Infraestrutura de redes e data centers
  • Comunicação industrial e IoT
  • CFTV, segurança e redes ELV
  • Cabeamento estruturado
  • Equipamentos, acessórios, ferramentas e instrumentos de teste

2. Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Sistemas de Comunicação – Comunicação Sem Fio e RF, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos de comunicação da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função envolve comunicação técnica, esclarecimento de requisitos, seleção de produtos, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações e acompanhamento de oportunidades relacionadas a telecomunicações, comunicação sem fio, RF, redes, IoT, segurança, data centers, integradores de sistemas e projetos de infraestrutura.

É um modelo de cooperação flexível, adequado para profissionais com experiência em comunicação sem fio, RF, sistemas de rádio, transmissão por micro-ondas, telecomunicações, comunicação industrial, IoT ou integração de sistemas.

A função não se limita à engenharia de operadoras de telecomunicações. Trata-se de uma posição técnica e de suporte a projetos, combinando conhecimento de comunicação, relacionamento com clientes, entendimento de requisitos, seleção de soluções e avanço comercial.

O candidato deverá apoiar:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Seleção de produtos sem fio e RF
  • Correspondência de soluções de comunicação
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação com clientes, contratantes e integradores
  • Coordenação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Avanço de projetos

3. Principais Responsabilidades

Suporte Técnico e Apoio a Projetos

Apoiar oportunidades no Brasil relacionadas a:

  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação sem fio e RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Links de micro-ondas
  • Comunicação industrial e IoT
  • Infraestrutura de redes e data centers
  • CFTV e sistemas de segurança
  • Projetos de infraestrutura e edifícios inteligentes
  • Integradores, contratantes, consultores e proprietários de projetos

Comunicar-se com clientes, contratantes, consultores, equipes de compras e demais partes envolvidas para entender contexto do projeto, requisitos técnicos, condições do local, cobertura, frequência, distância de transmissão, estrutura de rede, ambiente de instalação e direção de aquisição.

Ajudar a SolutionMall a identificar oportunidades qualificadas e avançá-las para discussões práticas de RFQ e cotação.

Seleção de Soluções Sem Fio e RF

Apoiar a seleção técnica de produtos e soluções, incluindo:

  • Equipamentos de comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF e radiocomunicação
  • Equipamentos de transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Antenas e acessórios RF
  • Módulos, gateways e roteadores industriais
  • Dispositivos IoT
  • Produtos de fibra óptica
  • Switches e dispositivos de rede
  • Cabeamento estruturado
  • Instrumentos de teste e ferramentas de instalação

Auxiliar clientes na escolha de produtos com base em aplicação, cobertura, distância de transmissão, estabilidade de sinal, frequência, largura de banda, ambiente, compatibilidade, instalação e manutenção.

RFQ, Cotação e Coordenação Comercial

Acompanhar informações de projeto, especificações técnicas, listas de aquisição, desenhos, orçamento, cronograma e processo de aprovação.

Converter interesses iniciais em RFQs ativos e discussões reais de cotação.

Coordenar com equipes da SolutionMall, fornecedores e clientes para manter oportunidades qualificadas em andamento.

Apoiar comparação de produtos, confirmação técnica, comunicação de cotações, negociação comercial e acompanhamento de pedidos quando necessário.

Feedback Técnico e de Mercado

Coletar e compartilhar informações sobre:

  • Demandas comuns de projetos de comunicação no Brasil
  • Necessidades de aplicação em comunicação sem fio e RF
  • Especificações preferidas
  • Expectativas de cobertura e frequência
  • Normas locais e processos de aprovação
  • Sensibilidade a preços
  • Concorrentes e canais de distribuição
  • Hábitos de compra, instalação e manutenção

Ajudar a SolutionMall a melhorar sua seleção de produtos, comunicação de projetos e estratégia de cooperação no Brasil.

4. Qualificações

Requisitos

Mais de 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais áreas:

  • Engenharia de sistemas de comunicação
  • Comunicação sem fio ou RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação industrial ou IoT
  • Fibra óptica e redes
  • Data centers ou infraestrutura de rede
  • CFTV e redes de segurança
  • Integração de sistemas
  • Suporte técnico a projetos
  • Vendas técnicas ou suporte de soluções de comunicação

O candidato deve ter familiaridade com produtos de comunicação e capacidade de compreender requisitos técnicos, seleção de produtos, RFQ, cotações e comunicação com clientes.

Também é desejável compreender cobertura de sinal sem fio, comunicação RF, distância de transmissão, seleção de antenas, conectividade de rede, ambiente de instalação e cenários de aplicação.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, contratantes, compras, fornecedores, distribuidores e stakeholders de projetos.

Proficiência profissional em português. Inglês será considerado uma vantagem.

Preferencial

  • Relacionamento com clientes, contratantes, integradores ou projetos no Brasil
  • Experiência com telecomunicações, infraestrutura, indústria, edifícios inteligentes ou distribuidores de equipamentos de comunicação
  • Experiência em RFQ, licitações, cotações, comunicação técnico-comercial ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro de comunicação, aprovação de projetos, canais de aquisição e normas locais
  • Experiência com equipamentos sem fio, RF, antenas, micro-ondas, roteadores industriais, gateways IoT, fibra óptica ou instrumentos de teste

5. Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação técnica e suporte a projetos.

As principais atividades incluem:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Seleção de produtos sem fio e RF
  • Correspondência de soluções de comunicação
  • Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação de produtos e soluções
  • Coordenação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço de projetos
  • Comunicação com clientes e contratantes

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer suporte regional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de negócios de longo prazo, com base na capacidade técnica, recursos de clientes, progresso dos projetos e contribuição real.

A função é adequada para profissionais com experiência ou acesso a projetos de comunicação sem fio, RF, telecomunicações, comunicação industrial, IoT, integração de sistemas ou canais de equipamentos de comunicação no Brasil.

6. Remuneração e Benefícios de Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e baseado na contribuição real, incluindo:

  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Avanço de RFQ
  • Suporte à seleção de produtos e soluções
  • Avanço de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios
  • Valor de cooperação de longo prazo

Os termos detalhados poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, conforme experiência, capacidade técnica, recursos de clientes, cobertura regional, relacionamento com projetos e contribuição real.

7. Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência em:

  • Comunicação sem fio

title: Analista De Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades: Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing. Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas. Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio. Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva. Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira. Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio. Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix. Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI). Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros. Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado. Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais. Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão. Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação. Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados. Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação). Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?

Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious CompoundsTM

We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.

At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.

Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus

Success Roadmap:

In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.

By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click

Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.

Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus

Success Roadmap:

In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.

By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click

Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements: Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German) Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details: Engagement type :Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred.
